listing.name: Political Map - Sector Map Layers
listing.summary: Currently in pre-release. Requires LazyLib and LunaLib. Safe to enable mid-save, uninstalled via settings.

description:
Currently in pre-release. Requires **LazyLib** and **LunaLib**. Safe to enable mid-save, uninstalled via settings.

Install it via [**TriOS**](https://trilink.wispborne.com/open.html?mod=%7B"url"%3A"https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FKlark-Morrigan%2FStarsector-Mod-KMU%2Freleases%2Flatest%2Fdownload%2Fkmu.version"%2C"id"%3A"kmu"%7D&dep=%7B"url"%3A"https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLazyWizard%2Flazylib%2Fmaster%2Fmod%2Flazylib.version"%2C"id"%3A"lw_lazylib"%7D&dep=%7B"url"%3A"https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FLukas22041%2FLunaLib%2Fmain%2FLunaLib.version"%2C"id"%3A"lunalib"%7D&dep=%7B"url"%3A"https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2FKlark-Morrigan%2FStarsector-Mod-KMLib%2Freleases%2Flatest%2Fdownload%2Fkmlib.version"%2C"id"%3A"kmlib"%7D) or by downloading [**KMLib**](https://github.com/Klark-Morrigan/Starsector-Mod-KMLib/releases/latest) (its dependency) and [**KMU**](https://github.com/Klark-Morrigan/Starsector-Mod-KMU/releases/latest) (the mod itself).

The **Political Map** is the first among **Sector Map Layers** and focuses on populated colonies and their allegiances, with **Faction**, **Alliance**, and **Claim** views. It shows up primarily on the map screen and the intel screen, with a collapsible sidebar as its control interface.

Made compatible with **Fast Rendering**, **Nexerelin** (alliances), **Random Assortment of Things** (minimap replacement). ||Can [play **Bad Apple**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mA9gAeQeEhA).||

Discuss in https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1549091275167240272
Forum thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36029.0
